klaim.bukti: We recorded the strawberry point clouds with a terrestrial laser scanner in a greenhouse, while apple point clouds were obtained from RGB images using photogrammetric reconstruction. [...] For the re-identification experiments, we focus exclusively on the strawberry dataset
klaim.perbaikan: Fusaro et al. segmented fruit in coloured point clouds (terrestrial laser scans of strawberries and a photogrammetric apple dataset), extracted a descriptor per fruit with a sparse convolutional network, and matched fruit between sessions with an attention-based network and a probabilistic assignment; re-identification between sessions was evaluated on the strawberry data only, and the apple data were used for instance segmentation only.
klaim.catatan: Segmentasi, deskriptor sparse CNN, matcher berbasis atensi, dan penugasan probabilistik sesuai sumber. Data apel (PFuji-Size) berasal dari fotogrametri citra RGB, bukan pemindaian laser, dan hanya dipakai untuk segmentasi instans; pencocokan antarsesi hanya diuji pada stroberi.

klaim.bukti: Training data annotation is usually indispensable for discriminative Re-ID model learning due to the large cross-camera variations. In the existence of large domain shift, we often need to annotate the training data in every new scenario.
klaim.catatan: Sumber menyatakan pembelajaran fitur diskriminatif Re-ID tertutup mengandaikan data latih beranotasi identitas yang cukup (h. 2-3). Sumber juga membahas Re-ID tanpa label atau berlabel terbatas sebagai latar terbuka; klaim naskah berlaku untuk latar tersupervisi.

klaim.bukti: By dissecting the involved components in developing a person Re-ID system, we categorize it into the closed-world and open-world settings.
klaim.catatan: Kajian ini adalah survei re-identifikasi orang di luar pertanian; tidak memuat bukti pertanian.

klaim.bukti: To train the YOLOv4 model, a large number of ripe FFB images were collected using an Intel Realsense Camera D435 [...] During data acquisition, a subject matter expert assisted in classifying the FFBs in terms of ripe or unripe.
klaim.catatan: YOLOv4, RealSense D435, dan pelabelan matang/mentah oleh pakar sesuai abstrak. Detektor ditujukan untuk tandan matang.

klaim.bukti: A database with more than 165,172 tomato cluster instances was built for tracking. [...] MOT trackers were compared by reducing the frame rate of the camera.
klaim.catatan: Empat pelacak (SORT, DeepSort, ByteTrack, BotSort), dataset MOT publik, dan penurunan laju bingkai sesuai abstrak. Abstrak menulis 'more than 165,172'; angka di naskah sama.

klaim.bukti: we herein establish a public multi-object tracking (MOT) dataset for tomato cluster counts, while evaluating and comparing state-of-the-art target detection and MOT-based algorithms.
klaim.catatan: Dataset MOT publik untuk tandan tomat; anotasi MOT memuat identitas lintas bingkai, dan MOTA dilaporkan.
